bio: Thijs Meliefste is a name synonymous with excellence. His restaurant is located in a picturesque setting, with a gorgeous terrace overlooking a marina on Veerse Meer lagoon. The decor in the intimate dining space is rather understated and evokes a sense of tranquillity. The glass-walled kitchen reveals a serene scene of food preparation. But think of it as the calm before the storm, because the arrival of the appetisers at your table brings a burst of intense sophistication. Chef Meliefste's cooking style is characterised by intricate details and a wide range of techniques. The natural bounty of Zeeland's soil and waters are his source of inspiration.
